_about: Package VF: the frame of the Twin Dial (facelift design), proposed values in dial units: u, v in R (R = the bezel ring's centre line, package VR's convention) from the midpoint M of the two dial centres, u right, v down; u_D = u_R / centre_distance_R. Lead reference 02 (the only sharp OEM facelift frame), cross-checked on 04 and 05 (bench / product pictures of the same design, less sharp, slightly different layout). Every value: source refs, uncertainty (R), status. Measured numbers per reference: frame_measured.json. Proposal for the message: message_panel.json.

centre_distance_R.status: verified (VR's canvas); 02 and 03 (in-car photos) agree to 0.0003, 04/05 are smaller units or composites
centre_distance_R.for: u_D conversion; VG owns the G20 value

extent_u.status: verified on 02 (symmetric about M to 0.001 R); 04/05 within 0.05 R

free_gap_to_bezel_R.status: verified (02): the bar floats; it does not touch either dial (bezel at v -0.835 is at u -1.33)

rule.status: verified (02: level to 0.001 R over 4 cells; thickness = 1 source px, unresolved, so 'one panel px or a little more')
rule.colour: white; under the highlighted tab it takes the tab's colour (02)

cell_fill.value: vertical gradient, clear at the top to grey just above the rule; 50 % at v -0.822 (02), -0.816 (04), -0.801 (05)

separators_u.shape: a dark 1-px gap followed by a light 1-px line at the left edge of the next cell (02, zoomed)

tabs.rule: icon tabs 0.22 +- 0.01 R wide (02: 0.229 0.228 0.217; 04: 0.212 0.216 0.216 0.207; 05: 0.210 0.207 0.206 0.226); the first tab is as wide as its icon + value (02: 0.418 R); the middle tab takes the rest (02: 1.186 R) and centres its content (02: content centre 0.100 vs cell centre 0.101)
tabs.status: verified on 02; 04/05 add a sixth tab (more / settings) at the right

content.status: verified (02); text: tab 1 value and the media title; icons: phone 0.125, nav 0.118

highlighted_tab.value: the whole cell filled flat in the meaning's colour from cell top to the rule, the rule under it in the same colour, its icon / text white
highlighted_tab.status: verified (shape); colours: VC. The classic generation (01, 03) uses an outlined trapezoid instead - not used

telltale_strip.status: verified on 02 only (04/05 bench units show none)
telltale_strip.on_g20: BMW's own telltales stay where they are; we draw nothing here (VG: hood and telltale zones)

bounds_v.status: verified (02): from the tab-bar rule to the bottom rule; the facelift draws NO border around it (02, 04, 05); the classic 03 does: box u [-0.847, 0.80], v [-0.785, 0.389]

bounds_u.value: free space between the bezels (+-0.937 R at v 0); content keeps inside +-0.77 R

refs.05: title rule +-0.66, scroll bar at u 0.820

page_grammar.refs: 02 (05 shows the same title / rule / value pattern at v -0.286 / -0.190 / 0.116, centred for a two-item list)

map.value: full-bleed between the dials, cut by the bezels: u -1.121..0.906, v -0.956..0.724; road label box v 0.354..0.664
map.refs: 01 (classic only; no facelift map frame available)

columns.rule: two columns, numbers RIGHT-aligned (right column: 4.5 / +25.5 end at 0.644 both, the decimal points line up at 0.541..0.559), units hang after the number
columns.status: verified for the right column (0.001 R); left column 694 / 14:43 end 0.010 R apart: hypothesis that it is the same rule

slots.refs: 02; 03 (classic) puts odometer / trip on line 1 and clock / icons / temperature on line 2 as well

replica_variant.value: one line: 'trip' value starting at u -1.157 (04 and 05 agree to 0.001), range ending at u +1.09..1.14, baseline v 0.95 (04) / 0.88 (05)
replica_variant.status: verified, not used (02 is the lead)

joining_outline.value: none: in the facelift the tab bar, the centre content and the bottom rule float in the black; nothing joins them to the dials (gaps 0.19 R at the bar, 0.13 R at the bottom rule)

reduced_view.value: not found: package VR published no further references

alignment_rules: everything of the frame is symmetric about M's vertical (02: bar +-1.139, title rule -0.731/+0.734, bottom rule -1.104/+1.106)
the tab-bar rule, the title rule and the bottom rule are level (02, rectified)
centred texts: page titles and the middle tab's content on u 0 / their cell centre
the bottom row's numbers are right-aligned in two columns, units hang
